generation_rule: registry_generation == from_registry_generation + 1 (both read from the ledger head at append time, never declared here)

manifest.repository: StegVerse-Labs/TVC (private; never vendored into a public repository)

digest_rule: admission_manifest_sha256 = 'sha256:' + sha256 of the canonical JSON bytes (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8) of this whole manifest; the manifest carries no status or digest of itself, so declaring the genesis needs no manifest edit and no merge
e0_checks_by_the_appender: the request is this schema, operation SV_CHANGE_ADMISSION_GENESIS, append_mode FROM_HEAD, ledger_ref refs/stegverse/organization-ledger, and admission_manifest_sha256 is a sha256 ref
the genesis-request PR is open, same-repository (head repository == base repository) and changes only control/sv-merge-admission/genesis-request.json
no SV_CHANGE_ADMISSION_GENESIS is already on the ledger, unless this request supersedes exactly the declared one (DENY GENESIS_ALREADY_DECLARED otherwise)
registry_generation == from_registry_generation + 1, both from the sealed base-state readback receipt (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3266), never declared here; the epoch is the ledger head's

Lane B's selected-tests receipt (stegverse.test-suite-skip-receipt/v1) at the genesis-request exact head: disposition ALLOW, counts.skipped 0, no refusal, its producer read at the base by byte pin; recorded as selected_tests_receipt {head_sha, receipt_sha256, disposition, skipped, tests, selected_files}
mode E0..E3 and, at E1+, a declared cross_llm_confirmation form (E0_CHECKS_PLUS_LATER_RECEIPTED_REVIEW with the review PENDING is enough)
verified_by_tvc: TVC's SV_CHANGE_ADMISSION_GENESIS_DECLARED recomputes admission_manifest_sha256 from its own committed manifest on every evaluation; the appender never needs the private manifest bytes (no pin-match against vendored bytes)

cross_llm_confirmation_at_e1.rule: degrades, never stops (manifest operating_modes.cross_llm_confirmation); the later review is appended as its own receipt; a DENY becomes an admission miss and a successor genesis

optional_inputs_e1_to_e3: LLM verifier receipts (pinned verifier digest), recorded as llm_verifier_receipts; never required
status_until_appended: every MERGE_ADMISSION evaluation is FAIL_CLOSED SV_CHANGE_ADMISSION_GENESIS_NOT_DECLARED with the six fields

supersedes.rule: the v2.1 request was never appended; this request replaces it (and, through it, the v2 request 7370db40). Only one genesis is appended, for the digest above; a receipt declaring a superseded digest is SV_CHANGE_ADMISSION_GENESIS_MISMATCH

the v2 request was never appended; this request replaces it for StegVerse-org/.github#167 ask (v). Only one genesis is appended, for the digest above; a receipt declaring the superseded digest is SV_CHANGE_ADMISSION_GENESIS_MISMATCH
